rooms.name: Champlain Cut
rooms.purpose: Teach the lead and the glass lesson before any reflection can lie to you.
rooms.layoutNote: Shore at the south, ice north. Three posts stand on floor. Thin-ice tiles sit off the aisle. The sign is the tell.

dialogue.text: Sound the three posts. Then read the glass rule. The ice off the posts is a rumor.

Sound post C. The safe path to the north door is marked.

script.note: Raise the glass. The true shore is the one the glass stops drawing.
Thaw the snow packed in the bell.
Ring. The near shore answers and the reflection stops walking.
Hang the coat on the true-shore peg.
Cross as an unfinished life. Needle and lead are both required by the machine.
Sound the center. It says this is the other shore.
Write the word already spoken by the lead: other.
